source: docs.arc.io sample apps + GitHub repository metadata
license: Index only (titles, links, tags). Each repo carries its own license (SPDX id from the GitHub API). Summaries are written by stable-build contributors; docs prose is not copied.
notes: summary, frontiers, blocks and starters[] are hand-maintained and survive a refresh. Frontier ids refer to frontiers.json; block ids refer to frontiers.json blocks[].

items.title: Arc commerce
items.summary: Users buy app credits with USDC through developer-controlled wallets; webhooks confirm settlement.

items.title: Arc P2P payments
items.summary: Person-to-person USDC payments without gas prompts, using passkey-protected modular (smart account) wallets.

items.title: Arc escrow
items.summary: Freelance escrow where an AI checks the delivered work before USDC is released (Refund Protocol).

items.title: Arc nanopayments
items.summary: An agent pays per call for paywalled APIs in sub-cent USDC amounts over x402.

items.title: Arc e-commerce payments
items.summary: Store checkout in USDC or EURC, held in escrow until the order completes (Commerce Payments Protocol).

items.title: USDC Onramp Demo
items.summary: Buy USDC by card or bank transfer and receive it in a browser wallet on Arc (App Kit Onramp).

items.title: Arc multichain wallet
items.summary: One USDC balance across chains, spent anywhere through Circle Gateway.

items.title: Arc fintech
items.summary: Treasury console that moves USDC between chains with Bridge Kit and Gateway.

items.title: Arc stablecoin FX
items.summary: USDC and EURC swaps with an app-level fee, built on App Kit Swap.

items.title: Arc DeFi lend and borrow
items.summary: Custom lending contract: post cirBTC as collateral and borrow USDC (Hardhat project).

items.title: Arc prediction markets
items.summary: Outcome markets resolved by UMA's optimistic oracle, with an AMM for trading position tokens.

starters.name: Payouts from a CSV (stable-build starter)
starters.summary: Pay many recipients in USDC from a CSV, with a memo per row for reconciliation, a live ledger and export.
starters.notes: Sends each chunk as Multicall3From.aggregate3 over Memo.memo calls. The docs do not cover nesting the two; the starter backs it with its own testnet receipts (docs/batch-memo-evidence.md in the template). A per-row mode sends one Memo transaction per row. EOA wallets only.
